item.title: Remember When: Ohio State’s Loss to Miami in the 1999 Kickoff Classic Sent Both Programs On Wildly Different Trajectories
item.description: Heading into the 1999 season, the general sentiment around Columbus was that John Cooper had finally broken through as head coach of Ohio State. The Buckeyes finished the 1998 season with an 11-1 record, including a rare victory over rival Michigan with Cooper at the helm, and ended the season at No. 2 in the AP Poll, behind national champions Tennessee.
